# neo declares a seat:start that rebuilds stale development themes

## Context

neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1480 makes a Fleet Start bring each seat checkout current before the harness launches. First it fast-forwards the checkout and installs its dependencies. Then it runs the repository's own `seat:start` npm script, so each repository declares what a fresh Start needs and Fleet names no tenant's build.

neo is the first repository that needs one. The operator's theme workflow is "build-themes once on a fresh checkout, then watch-themes before changing SCSS", with one stated edge case: "after a pull with peer scss changes you need build-themes too". A Start that fast-forwards a seat's checkout is exactly that pull, and nothing rebuilds the themes after it.

## The Problem

After a fast-forward brings in SCSS changes, the checkout serves the CSS it compiled before them until someone runs `npm run build-themes`. The dev server warns about it (#15666) and `watch-themes` refuses a stale tree, but neither rebuilds it. Running the full theme build on every Start would make most starts slower for nothing, because most starts bring in no SCSS change.

## The Architectural Reality

- `package.json:24`: `"build-themes": "node ./buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f"`.
- `buildScripts/util/developmentThemeAssets.mjs:184`: `inspectDevelopmentThemeAssets()`, the freshness and completeness check that the dev server's warning and `watch-themes` already reuse. It returns `ready: false` when any non-partial SCSS input lacks a CSS output at least as new as the newest SCSS source, or when the theme map is stale or incomplete.
- `buildScripts/util/developmentThemeAssets.mjs:285`: `runDevelopmentThemeBuild()`, the one canonical non-interactive development build (`DEVELOPMENT_THEME_BUILD_COMMAND`).
- Fleet runs `npm run seat:start` after the checkout's install, with the operator's login-shell `npm`, `PATH` and a credential-free environment. Its outcome lands on the seat's start row, and a failure never blocks the launch (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1480).

## The Fix

Add a `seat:start` script to `package.json` that runs `runDevelopmentThemeBuild()` only when `inspectDevelopmentThemeAssets()` reports `ready: false`, and otherwise exits 0 at once. Both pieces already exist, so this adds an entry point, not another freshness check. A new `.mjs` entry point goes through the structural pre-flight first, against its `buildScripts/` siblings.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `npm run seat:start` on a checkout whose development themes are current exits 0 without building.
- [ ] After an SCSS source changes, `npm run seat:start` rebuilds the development themes, and a second run is a no-op.

The post-merge installed receipt moved to neomjs/neo-agent-skills#289, so this ticket closes with its PR. That receipt is one Fleet restart of a stale seat showing `seatStart: {state: 'ran'}`, current themes, and skills matching the pin, and #289's Step 1 retirement waits on the same restart.

## Out of Scope

- `build-all` on Start.
- Any change to Fleet (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1480).
- A read-only freshness command. `watch-themes` already is that check, and a separate one was withdrawn for that reason (#17900).

### Reviewed contract record for PR #20475

This records the existing ticket/consumer contract; it adds no scope or author action.

| Surface | Owner | Behavior checked |
|---|---|---|
| `npm run seat:start` | Engine `package.json` and `buildScripts/helpers/seatStart.mjs` | Runs in the selected checkout; current themes exit 0 without building. The exported function's explicit `repoRoot` seam is not a new CLI flag. |
| Missing/stale output | Existing `ensureDevelopmentThemeAssets()` | One canonical `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all`, then reinspect CSS and map completeness before success. |
| Failure | Existing build/revalidation seam and CLI catch | Builder failure or incomplete output exits 1 with the recovery command on stderr. Importing the module invokes no build. |
| Fleet/installed receipt | Brain's Start path; Skills #289 | Fleet retains execution ordering and failure policy. The installed restart receipt remains outside this Engine leaf, as the current ticket already states. |

At `9fee8453a07d5472a74431cc0400e5723ba80a18`, exact package commands plus five unchanged/changed production source files ran in a disposable fixture through real Dart Sass: missing outputs built red CSS; an SCSS change built green CSS; the next run was current with unchanged CSS mtime. Separate real-CLI controls checked canonical arguments/cwd, exit-7 → exit-1, incomplete successful builder → exit-1, and inert import. Hosted unit job [128068324190](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42268975349/job/128068324190) visibly executed all five new cases.
